phase: Phase 9 AI/ML Dataset Readiness, Leakage-Free Experiments & Vision Benchmarking
scientific_integrity_attestation: Sahaay AI prioritizes scientific validity over producing unvalidated checkpoints. Because available training data suffers from complete source-label confounding (Cramer's V = 1.0) and metadata shortcut exploitability (85.97% pixel-free test accuracy), production Vision V4 model training is formally NOT_RUN. All reported numbers represent controlled diagnostic baselines or historical transfers.

track_a_existing_data_diagnostics.track_title: Track A — Existing-Data Diagnostic Experiments on Manifest V4
track_a_existing_data_diagnostics.dataset_scope: Clemson FloodIMG (N=739, label=1) vs Virenbr11 Plain & Potholes (N=740, label=0)
track_a_existing_data_diagnostics.split_architecture: Leak-free, globally clustered Manifest V4 (Train=1034, Val=223, Test=221)

source_label_confounding.interpretation: Source identity is 100% collinear with the class label.

metadata_only_file_size.notes: Single non-semantic feature separates classes with >80% accuracy.

track_a_existing_data_diagnostics.scientific_finding: Even when near-duplicate leakage is completely eliminated (0 pairs at Hamming distance <= 2), a model evaluated on this split achieves high accuracy by exploiting camera acquisition profiles. Metrics on this test set do NOT constitute valid evidence of real-world flood detection.

track_b_cross_source_transfer.track_title: Track B — Historical Model Cross-Source Transfer & Stress Testing

v2_historical_on_unseen_pavement.finding: V2 completely collapses on out-of-distribution clean asphalt, falsely flagging 94% as flooded.

v3_clean_vs_monsoon_under_optical_degrad.finding: Monsoon data augmentation provides robust hard-negative rejection (0% false positives on puddles) but slightly lowers recall on severe spray.

roham1_transfer_audit.defect: Non-flood images are 100% 224x224 fixed thumbnails of indoor objects/animals; flood images are high-res web photos.
roham1_transfer_audit.finding: Evaluating models on Roham1 tests resolution-matching shortcuts rather than flood generalization.

track_c_production_training_readiness.track_title: Track C — Vision V4 Production Training Decision & Gating
track_c_production_training_readiness.decision_verdict: NO-GO FOR PRODUCTION VISION V4 TRAINING

blocking_gates.requirement: At least 2 independent acquisition sources each providing >= 200 flooded and >= 200 non-flooded road images.
blocking_gates.current_state: 0 sources currently satisfy multi-class road criteria.

blocking_gates.requirement: Cramer's V <= 0.30 and Mutual Information <= 0.20 bits across Source x Class.
blocking_gates.current_state: Cramer's V = 1.0000, Mutual Information = 1.0000 bits (complete collinearity).

blocking_gates.requirement: Pixel-free metadata diagnostic test accuracy <= 65.0% and ROC-AUC <= 0.60.
blocking_gates.current_state: Pixel-free Random Forest achieves 85.97% test accuracy and 0.9145 ROC-AUC.

blocking_gates.requirement: Real-world field observations verified and ingested under approved protocol.
blocking_gates.current_state: 0 real-world observations acquired (activation gate blocked at BLOCKED_NOT_READY_FOR_LIVE_PILOT).

required_collection_target_to_unlock_tra.locations: Minimum 4 Hyderabad candidate elevated vantage corridors (Rasoolpura, Lakdikapul, Tolichowki, Malakpet).
conditions_per_location: Condition A: Dry pavement baseline (>= 200 daylight, >= 100 night lit).
Condition B: Wet pavement / puddles / potholes without inundation (>= 200 wet road hard negatives).
Condition C: True road inundation with water depth >= 5 cm (>= 200 validated flood scenes).
required_collection_target_to_unlock_tra.annotation_protocol: Dual blind annotation with Cohen's Kappa >= 0.85.
required_collection_target_to_unlock_tra.governance_rule: Training remains NOT_RUN until this target is legitimately collected and audited.

decision_engine_alert_levels.CLEAR: No flood evidence, normal traffic flow
decision_engine_alert_levels.ADVISORY: Rainfall threshold or wet pavement advisory, caution recommended
decision_engine_alert_levels.WARNING: Standing water or heavy rainfall, potential disruption
decision_engine_alert_levels.EMERGENCY: Severe waterlogging corroboration required by physical crew or severe gauge telemetry
